def VTask.banana {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} (u v : α) (edgeSet : Set β) : Graph α β :=
  { adj := λ a b => if {a, b} = {u, v} then edgeSet else ∅,
    symm := by
      intros a b e h
      dsimp [adj]
      cases h with
      | inl h => 
        have h_sym := by simp only [Set.ext_iff, mem_set_of_eq, and_comm, or_comm] at h
        exact ⟨_, h⟩
      | inr h => 
        have h_sym := by simp only [Set.ext_iff, mem_set_of_eq, and_comm, or_comm] at h
        exact ⟨_, h⟩ }
